title: Nonvanishing of the orthogonal component
statement:
Let $V$ be a real inner product space, and let $u, x \in V$ be unit vectors, $
orm{u} = 1$ and $
orm{x} = 1$, with $\langle x, uangle \le 0$ and $x 
eq u$, $x 
eq -u$. Then the component of $x$ orthogonal to $u$ is nonzero, that is, $x - \langle x, uangle\, u 
eq 0$.
hypotheses_covered: V is a real inner product space
inner product of x and u is at most 0
x is not equal to u
